description: This Java interface defines a PricingService responsible for calculating product prices, including methods that account for rebates, customer details, product attributes, and formatting display amounts with currency considerations.

classes.name: PricingService
classes.description: Service interface for calculating product pricing, including methods for total price calculation, applying rebates, customer-specific adjustments, and formatting price display.

methods.name: calculateProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price of a product, considering rebates and other factors. Overloaded to handle different scenarios with optional customer and attribute parameters.

methods.name: getDisplayAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into a user display string, optionally including currency and locale considerations.

methods.name: getStringAmount
methods.description: Returns a string representing the amount without currency symbol, formatted for display.
